notes: «[-/3] معاني الاخبار والامالي:» is a source label and the leading number is not a link. «عن عمه محمد بن أبي القاسم» is one link named by the name alone (rule 7).

The Imam «الصادق» after «عن» stays a narrator. «قال: قال أمير المؤمنين» names Ali in the words after the chain: he is the last link, imam_in_text (owner ruling 2). The ellipses in the matn are the text's own.
